subgoals: Distinguish the fitted line from a point-to-point line

visual.title: The line that minimizes the squared gaps
visual.caption: Drag a point and watch the sum of squares. The line always passes through the mean point, and one far point pulls it harder than a near one.

predict.question: One point sits far above the rest. What does least squares do with it?
options: Pulls the line toward it more than a near point would
predict.explain: The residual is squared, so a point twice as far away contributes four times as much to the sum being minimized.
